name: Convent de la Missio
insider_take: This stunning 17th-century convent turned luxury boutique hotel sits in the heart of Palma's Old Town, where centuries of history meet contemporary Balearic sophistication.
whats_special: The hotel preserves original stone arches, vaulted ceilings, and cloisters from its monastic past, while the rooftop terrace offers breathtaking views of Palma Cathedral's Gothic spires. The building's transformation maintains the spiritual tranquility of its convent origins, creating an oasis of calm just steps from Palma's bustling shopping districts.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner on the rooftop terrace - you'll have an unobstructed view of La Seu Cathedral illuminated against the Mediterranean twilight, one of Palma's most Instagram-worthy moments.
dont_miss: Explore the nearby Almudaina Palace and Arab Baths, both within a 5-minute walk. The hotel's location puts you at the epicenter of Palma's cultural triangle, where you can trace the city's Moorish, Jewish, and Christian heritage without ever needing transportation.
pros: Historic 17th-century convent beautifully converted into luxury boutique hotel
Prime location in Palma's Old Town within walking distance of cathedral and attractions
Exceptional spa facilities with indoor pool and comprehensive wellness treatments
Elegant rooms featuring original architectural details and modern luxury amenities
cons: Limited parking availability due to historic city center location
Rooms may vary in size due to historic building constraints
